propositions: Dependabot PR #125 proposes two dependency bumps: zizmor 1.28.0→1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0; only the zizmor bump is safe to land immediately.

mcp 2.0.0 removes the mcp.server.fastmcp module, which is imported by src/rebar/mcp_server.py and scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py, plus other v1 import paths in the MCP subsystem remain incompatible with mcp 2.0.
The mcp 2.0 migration is tracked separately under ticket 732b-51df-acf2-477b and must not be conflated with this zizmor-only update.
Landing the zizmor 1.29.0 bump requires updating pyproject.toml and regenerating uv.lock with 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor', leaving mcp pinned at <2.
The change must pass uv lock --check, make lint (with zizmor 1.29.0 audits), make typecheck, and the test suite before merge through Gerrit.
